Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Generate a Helm chart deploying a Postgres database for a non-production environment: StatefulSet, headless Service, PVC, Secret for credentials, and an init job to create the application database.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Helm chart templates (YAML; provide Chart.yaml, values.yaml, and templates/ as separate files concatenated with '---' YAML document separators and clearly labeled '# FILE: <path>' comments)

Task: Generate a Helm chart deploying a Postgres database for a non-production environment: StatefulSet, headless Service, PVC, Secret for credentials, and an init job to create the application database.

Output only the Helm chart templates (YAML; provide Chart.yaml, values.yaml, and templates/ as separate files concatenated with '---' YAML document separators and clearly labeled '# FILE: <path>' comments) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
# FILE: Chart.yaml
apiVersion: v2
name: postgres-nonprod
description: Non-production Postgres with StatefulSet, headless service, PVC, secret and init job
type: application
version: 0.1.0
appVersion: "16"
---
# FILE: values.yaml
replicaCount: 1
image:
  repository: postgres
  tag: "16-alpine"
  pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
service:
  port: 5432
persistence:
  storageClassName: ""
  size: 10Gi
secret:
  postgresUser: postgres
  postgresPassword: change-me-in-prod
  appDatabase: appdb
resources:
  requests:
    cpu: 100m
    memory: 256Mi
  limits:
    cpu: 500m
    memory: 512Mi
securityContext:
  runAsNonRoot: true
  runAsUser: 999
  fsGroup: 999
---
# FILE: templates/secret.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: {{ include "postgres-nonprod.fullname" . }}-secret
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "postgres-nonprod.name" . }}
type: Opaque
stringData:
  POSTGRES_USER: {{ .Values.secret.postgresUser }}
  POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{ .Values.secret.postgresPassword }}
  POSTGRES_DB: postgres
  APP_DATABASE: {{ .Values.secret.appDatabase }}
---
# FILE: templates/service.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: {{ include "postgres-nonprod.fullname" . }}
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "postgres-nonprod.name" . }}
spec:
  clusterIP: None
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "postgres-nonprod.name" . }}
  ports:
    - port: {{ .Values.service.port }}
      targetPort: 5432
---
# FILE: templates/statefulset.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: {{ include "postgres-nonprod.fullname" . }}
spec:
  serviceName: {{ include "postgres-nonprod.fullname" . }}
  replicas: {{ .Values.replicaCount }}
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "postgres-nonprod.name" . }}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "postgres-nonprod.name" . }}
    spec:
      securityContext:
        {{- toYaml .Values.securityContext | nindent 8 }}
      containers:
        - name: postgres
          image: "{{ .Values.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.image.tag }}"
          imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.image.pullPolicy }}
          envFrom:
            - secretRef:
                name: {{ include "postgres-nonprod.fullname" . }}-secret
          ports:
            - containerPort: 5432
          volumeMounts:
            - name: data
              mountPath: /var/lib/postgresql/data
          resources:
            {{- toYaml .Values.resources | nindent 12 }}
  volumeClaimTemplates:
    - metadata:
        name: data
      spec:
        accessModes: ["ReadWriteOnce"]
        storageClassName: {{ .Values.persistence.storageClassName | quote }}
        resources:
          requests:
            storage: {{ .Values.persistence.size }}
---
# FILE: templates/init-job.yaml
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: {{ include "postgres-nonprod.fullname" . }}-init-db
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "postgres-nonprod.name" . }}
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      restartPolicy: OnFailure
      containers:
        - name: init-db
          image: "{{ .Values.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.image.tag }}"
          envFrom:
            - secretRef:
                name: {{ include "postgres-nonprod.fullname" . }}-secret
          command:
            - /bin/sh
            - -c
            - |
              until pg_isready -h {{ include "postgres-nonprod.fullname" . }} -U $POSTGRES_USER; do sleep 2; done
              psql -h {{ include "postgres-nonprod.fullname" . }} -U $POSTGRES_USER -c "CREATE DATABASE $APP_DATABASE;" || true
---
# FILE: templates/_helpers.tpl
{{- define "postgres-nonprod.name" -}}
{{- default .Chart.Name .Values.nameOverride | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
{{- end }}
{{- define "postgres-nonprod.fullname" -}}
{{- printf "%s-%s" .Release.Name (include "postgres-nonprod.name" .) | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
{{- end }}
